title: Availability
description: Close dates for one tour or for every tour, and see how full each date is.

calendar.hint: Click a date (or press Enter; move with the arrow keys) to select it, then pick a later date for a range. Past dates can't be closed.
calendar.toursClosed: {count, plural, one {# tour closed} other {# tours closed}}

day.bookings: {count, plural, =0 {no bookings} one {# booking} other {# bookings}}
day.toursClosed: {count, plural, one {# tour closed} other {# tours closed}}

panel.title: Close dates
panel.empty: Select a date in the calendar, or enter a range of up to 92 days.
panel.loadError: We couldn't check these dates. Please try again.
panel.summary: {count, plural, one {# date} other {# dates}} selected: {range}.
panel.alreadyClosed: {count, plural, one {# is} other {# are}} already closed.
panel.affected: {bookings, plural, one {# pending or confirmed booking} other {# pending or confirmed bookings}} ({seats, plural, one {# traveller} other {# travellers}}) fall on these dates. Closing does not cancel them, so contact those travellers if needed.
panel.closedAllNotice: This date is closed for all tours. Switch to All tours to reopen it.
panel.reasonPlaceholder: For example: Nyepi, road closure, guide on leave
panel.allClosed: Every selected date is already closed.
panel.success: {count, plural, =0 {No new dates were closed.} one {# date closed.} other {# dates closed.}}
panel.successAffected: {count, plural, one {# booking on these dates stays active.} other {# bookings on these dates stay active.}}
panel.reopened: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to reopen.} one {# date reopened.} other {# dates reopened.}}

list.title: Upcoming closures
list.description: Consecutive dates closed together are shown as one line.
list.confirm: Reopen {dates} for {tour}? Travellers will be able to book these dates again.

empty.title: No upcoming closures
empty.description: Every future date is open for booking.
